# Issue 3: Review throughput

## Description
Improve review application throughput with priority queue and auto-approval features.

## Tasks
- [ ] Add priority queue filter in ReviewCard/FilterBar (high anomaly first)
- [ ] Implement auto-approve for low-risk items (pass all V1-V11)
